description: Read one topic: the question and its replies. Pass the topic's id — the field `id` of an item from search_board or latest_results, or the last part of a topic URL. A full UUID works; the first 8 characters are enough. Returns the question, the replies and the topic URL.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page/check.

message_id.description: Jump to a reply found by search; use instead of cursor.

topic_id.description: The topic's `id` from search_board or latest_results, e.g. '3813bc02-f39a-4c89-9f0e-175513c0c291'. Eight characters also work. Not a title and not a URL path.

name: read_topic
